_about: Level 1's own targets: full-size subjects of the 0.4 rounds, painted freehand with the toolkit (bench/scripts/v3.mjs). They are NOT part of the public suite (bench/v2/crops.json), its leaderboard or its routine runs. Files are relative to bench/v3/. A benchmark picture's target is made by bench/scripts/add-level-one-target.mjs from its registered source on the standard sheet (`subject`); `unit` is the automatic painting's counted work, for the runaway guard: a target without one is not run.

crops.name: Yale Rosewalk, full size
crops.style: loose ink-and-watercolor field sketch, ink led: a college walk with a gate and dappled shade
crops.source: ink-and-watercolour picture made by the image generator in Codex (OpenAI) from Carol M. Highsmith's photograph of Yale University (Library of Congress, LC-DIG-highsm-19255)
crops.licence: follows its source: Carol M. Highsmith's photograph, Library of Congress (LC-DIG-highsm-19255), "No known restrictions on publication"; modified with the image generator in Codex (OpenAI); see NOTICE

crops.name: A Fisherman's Daughter, full size
crops.style: watercolor and gouache over faint pencil, no ink: three girls in straw hats seated on a stone wall looking at a lobster, an upturned boat and grass behind, a sandy shore in front (Winslow Homer)
crops.source: Winslow Homer, A Fisherman's Daughter, 1873, Cleveland Museum of Art 1943.660; CC0

unit.from: prepared homer-daughter at f58e226f (v0.4.0-rc.2): one full look of the automatic plan; its full-size painting counted 11321 water steps
